encoding.decode: dT_microK = value / 255 * (maxMicroK - minMicroK) + minMicroK   (0 -> -300 µK, 255 -> +300 µK; values beyond ±300 µK are clipped)
encoding.shader: s = texture(...).r in [0,1]; t = 2*s - 1 in [-1,1] (= ΔT/300 µK) -> cmbColorNode(t)
encoding.colorSpace: data, not colour: load with texture.colorSpace = NoColorSpace (no sRGB decode)

convention.pixelCentres: column i (0-based, left to right) of W: l = (180 - 360*(i+0.5)/W) mod 360 deg; row j (0-based, top to bottom) of H: b = 90 - 180*(j+0.5)/H deg
convention.galacticCentre: l = 0 lies exactly on the boundary between columns W/2-1 and W/2 (u = 0.5); u = 0.25 is l = 90°, u = 0.75 is l = 270°, u = 0 and u = 1 are l = 180° (wrap: use RepeatWrapping on S)
convention.galacticCartesian: x -> (l=0°, b=0°) Galactic Centre, y -> (l=90°, b=0°), z -> North Galactic Pole (b=+90°); right-handed
convention.dirToUv: l = atan2(d.y, d.x); b = asin(d.z); u = fract(0.5 - l/(2π)); v = 0.5 + b/π  (v for three.js flipY = true, the TextureLoader default; image row fraction from top = 1 - v = 0.5 - b/π)
convention.threeEquirectUV: three.js equirectUV(dirWorld) [u = atan(d.z, d.x)/(2π) + 0.5, v = asin(d.y)/π + 0.5] samples this texture correctly when world = (x_G, z_G, -y_G): world +X = Galactic Centre, world +Y = North Galactic Pole, world -Z = (l=90°, b=0°). Proper rotation, not mirrored.
convention.orientation: sky as seen from inside the celestial sphere, same as published Planck all-sky maps (Galactic Centre in the middle, l increasing to the left)

release: Planck 2018 (PR3) SMICA CMB map, R3.00 full mission
smoothing: Gaussian beam FWHM 5′ applied in harmonic space (lmax 6143, map2alm iter 1), on top of SMICA's native 5′ resolution
resampling: bilinear HEALPix interpolation (healpy get_interp_val), 2x2 supersampled and box-averaged for 4096x2048; 2048x1024 and 1024x512 box-downsampled from the 4096 float image before quantisation

previewColorMap.interpolation: piecewise linear in linear-light RGB between stops (mirrors cmbColor() in src/shared/color.ts), sRGB-encoded

stats.note: pixel statistics of the 4096x2048 float image (equirectangular, not area-weighted)
